profile.headline: SDE @ Expedia
profile.summary:
I enjoy applying my tech skills to solve real-world problems. Currently a senior studying Computer Science at the University of Washington.

Looking to tackle complex problems, creatively meet customer demands in a collaborative environment, and constantly learn. Let's connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Develop and deploy Container App on Microsoft Azure using Bicep, and PowerShell script to build the project infrastructure for the Data Platform team.
Fix bugs and upgrade the JSON, Bicep files, and PowerShell scripts to improve reliability and efficiency by 30% of the original time.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated with another intern to create an organization map from the company’s database using React.
Customized the sign-in webpage of Symetra by implementing Amazon Cognito UI with AWS CLI.
Adhered to the Scrum development process by performing standups, sprints, and retrospectives.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), React.js and +4 skills

projects.title: EZ Triva
projects.description: Create the trivia game by Javascript, HTML, CSS. Generate questions, answers from the jservice.io database.

projects.title: Husky Code
projects.description: Husky Code is our attempt at creating an open source, member-driven (and prettier) version of UW's PracticeIt. The idea is to take features we like from HackerRank, LeetCode, etc., and implement it on our product. We are planning on creating a full scale web application, so you can imagine we'd need any willing hands on deck. Whether you're a database expert or are just looking to play with any aspect of web development, you are in the right place!
